purpose: Predeclared synthetic held-out qualification; excludes the two development diagnostic inputs
prompt: Use exactly the requested JSON envelope. schemaVersion is the string 1, never a number. Classify payments, invoices, refunds and subscription charges as billing. Classify software errors, broken features, installation and connectivity problems as support. The source is an unambiguous customer request: choose its correct allowed label. Use status ok and a non-null example when the category is clear. Do not invent another category or copy the example label without reading the source.
per_case_seed: 17 + heldout index, reset identically for each variant, device, mode, phase and replicate
absolute_quality_rationale: At least23of24 distinct unambiguous requests must yield a correct accepted output in every candidate phase/replicate, alongside the conservative paired non-regression gate. This bounds fixture error and never claims population accuracy. The aspirational goal remains24of24.
quality_metric: Correct accepted source-label pairs divided by all 24 held-out inputs; omitted, skipped, malformed and wrong-label results are incorrect. Candidate cannot lose an accepted correct pair relative to baseline (predeclared tolerance 0.02; one of 24 exceeds it). Report paired counts and exact binomial confidence bounds separately from the conservative deterministic non-regression gate.
throughput_metric: Primary: correct accepted examples per minute over the entire child delivery (cold load, first24, warm24, every attempt/repair and one final unload). Each phase represents24 independent one-source generation requests; repeated phases/replicates are timing repetitions, never additional distinct quality cases. Report first-batch load/inference, warm inference, final shared cleanup and whole-child elapsed separately; never charge the single unload to both phase rates. Cohorts never pool devices or modes. Require median paired whole-child accepted-throughput ratio>=1.20 in at least one matched positive-baseline generative cohort, with all candidate cohorts meeting absolute and paired quality/cleanup gates. A zero baseline has no finite relative percentage: retain absolute rates and mark that ratio undefined.
resource_metrics: Absolute and incremental process RSS sampled every 5ms; peak allocated/reserved CUDA bytes and post-unload runtime floor; model/device placement and physical child exit. A test timeout or emergency memory ceiling is not an approved product resource budget.
